title: Best of Thailand and Malaysia
alt: The Petronas Twin Towers lit up above the Kuala Lumpur skyline at dusk
transport: Private sedan transfers with shared tour coaches and a speedboat crossing

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: Two countries in six nights without rushing. Beach first, then two capitals that are easy to walk.
expert.tip: Book the Bangkok to Kuala Lumpur flight in the morning so you still get the evening on Jalan Alor. Carry ringgit in small notes for the street food stalls.

summary: Seven days across Thailand and Malaysia. Two nights on the Pattaya coast with a speedboat day at Coral Island, two in Bangkok with a full day temple tour, then two in Kuala Lumpur with the Twin Towers and Merdeka Square.
included: Included: 6 nights in 3 hotels with daily breakfast; Coral Island speedboat tour from Pattaya; full day Bangkok city tour; half day Kuala Lumpur city tour; 11 airport, intercity and sightseeing transfers; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Bangkok to Kuala Lumpur flight; visa charges; travel insurance; lunches and dinners; entry tickets not listed; personal expenses.

1: Arrival at Suvarnabhumi Airport and private sedan transfer down to Pattaya
Check in at Bella Villa Prima and keep the evening free
Optional: the Sanctuary of Truth, Mini Siam or an hour on Jomtien beach
2: Breakfast, then shared transfer to the Bali Hai pier
Speedboat transfer across to Coral Island for the day
Swim and sunbathe at Tawaen beach, water sports payable on the sand
Return speedboat and shared transfer to your Pattaya hotel
3: Breakfast, check out and private sedan transfer up to Bangkok
Check in and spend the afternoon however you like
Optional: Wat Arun across the river, Chatuchak market or Madame Tussauds
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the full day city tour
The Golden Buddha at Wat Traimit and Wat Maha Phruettharam
A stop at the gem gallery before the ride back to the hotel
Evening free around the markets near your hotel
5: Breakfast, check out and private transfer to Suvarnabhumi Airport
Optional: flight from Bangkok to Kuala Lumpur, booked separately and not included
Private transfer from Kuala Lumpur airport to your city hotel
Optional: dinner on Jalan Alor or the Thean Hou temple at dusk
6: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the half day city tour
The Petronas Twin Towers, KL Tower and Merdeka Square
Tugu Negara and the gates of Istana Negara on the way back
Afternoon free for the malls and markets of Bukit Bintang
7: Breakfast and an easy check out
Private sedan transfer to Kuala Lumpur International Airport

program.name: Coral Island and easy evenings
program.description: Two nights on the Gulf coast with a speedboat day at Koh Larn and the Pattaya night markets a short ride away.

activities.name: Coral Island by Speedboat
activities.description: A speedboat day out to Koh Larn with clear water at Tawaen beach, loungers on the sand and water sports if you want them.

activities.name: Sanctuary of Truth
activities.description: An enormous carved teak temple on the shore at Naklua, still being built by hand after forty years.

activities.name: Mini Siam
activities.description: Scale models of Thai and world landmarks set in gardens, an easy hour for families before dinner.

stops.name: Bangkok
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Convenient Park, close to the airport road and local markets

program.name: Temples, gems and city streets
program.description: Two nights in the capital with a full day tour of the Golden Buddha and the old temple quarter, and a free afternoon for markets.

activities.name: Full Day Bangkok City Tour
activities.description: A shared coach tour taking in the Golden Buddha at Wat Traimit, Wat Maha Phruettharam and a gem gallery.

activities.name: Wat Arun
activities.description: The temple of dawn on the west bank, covered in porcelain and best reached by the cross river ferry.

activities.name: Chatuchak Weekend Market
activities.description: Thousands of stalls across a vast weekend market, best reached by Skytrain and best walked early.

activities.name: Kuala Lumpur Half Day City Tour

activities.name: Jalan Alor Food Street
